code:
{% raw %}

# .github/workflows/publish.yml
- uses: docker/login-action@v3
  with:
    registry: ghcr.io
    username: ${{ github.actor }}
    password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}   # automatically provided by GitHub Actions

- uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
  with:
    context: .
    push: true
    tags: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
    # github.ref_name is the tag you pushed (e.g., v0.2.0)
{% endraw %}
description: Workflow that logs into GHCR using GITHUB_TOKEN, builds and pushes image with tag from ref_name, triggered manually.

steps.description: Login: docker/login-action@v3 authenticates to ghcr.io with github.actor and GITHUB_TOKEN.
Build and push: docker/build-push-action@v6 builds from context, pushes true, tags with repository and ref_name.

title: GitHub Actions: Container Publish Workflow
